item.title: [Peter Yang] Antigravity远程控制小技巧：手机也能聊
item.description:
@petergyang · 查看 X 原推文 ↗

中文翻译

给那些正在用 @antigravity 玩 Neon 的朋友们一个小提示：

1. 打开 https://t.co/GRhlnGkO1i 2. 点“查看更多”，然后点分享按钮 3. 点“添加到主屏幕”

这样你就能在手机上通过远程控制，跟所有 Antigravity 的对话线程聊天了。

虽然 Antigravity 还没有手机应用（暂时），但我觉得它的远程控制其实比 Claude 的更好用，因为所有对话线程默认都能用。

英文原推文

For those of you trying out @antigravity for Neon, here's a quick tip:

1. Go to https://t.co/GRhlnGkO1i 2. Tap see more and then the share button 3. Tap Add to Home Screen

Then you can talk to all your Antigravity threads via remote control on mobile.

Even though Antigravity doesn't have a mobile app (yet), I find its remote control actually better than Claude's because all the threads are available by default.

item.title: [Guillermo Rauch] 从Hello World到可交付产品：用开放智能栈打造你自己的私人购物Agent
item.description:
@rauchg · 查看 X 原推文 ↗

中文翻译

我第一次试用 @eve 的内部预发布版本时，拿一个私人购物助手 agent 当我的「hello world」。它能跑起来，但很多基础设施还缺着。

现在不一样了：@agentcardhq 已经有了，模型更强了，iMessage 和 WhatsApp 的 eve 通道也成熟了，性能大幅提升——而且没有在持久性和加密上做妥协。

结果就是，你可以基于我们的开放智能栈，交付一个 Muse / Instinct 这个水准的平台，而且完全由你自己掌控。体验非常愉悦。我强烈建议你试试：拿这个模板跑起来，改成你自己的东西。

英文原推文

When I first tried an internal pre-release version of @eve, a personal shopper agent was my "hello world". It worked, but a lot of the infrastructure was missing.

Now, @agentcardhq exists, models are better, iMessage and WhatsApp eve channels are mature, and performance is vastly improved (without trading off durability and encryption.)

The result is you can ship a platform of the caliber of Muse / Instinct, that you fully control, on our open intelligence stack. The experience is pure delight. I highly recommend you try this. Run with this template. Make it your own.
